subject.title: fix(channels): enforce native chat protocol fidelity

question: Should existing Mattermost fixture identifiers receive a compatibility translation path, or should this PR intentionally require an immediate migration to native 26-character IDs?
rationale: The stricter contract is consistent with provider fidelity, but choosing whether existing Crabline fixtures must migrate immediately is an operator-impact decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Add migration guidance
options.body: Preserve the strict server contract while documenting or implementing fixture and OpenClaw-bridge translation for legacy identifiers.

options.title: Accept immediate cutover
options.body: Merge the strict native-ID requirement and explicitly communicate that existing non-native Mattermost fixtures must be updated.

recommendation.title: Add migration guidance
recommendation.body: Preserve the strict server contract while documenting or implementing fixture and OpenClaw-bridge translation for legacy identifiers.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member currently coordinating the affected server, test, and documentation surfaces.
